Usage: droide search|find [options] <query>

Search across local sessions (messages, documents, tool results)

Arguments:
  query                 Query text (case-insensitive substring)

Options:
  --kind <kind>         Filter by kind:
                        message_text|document|tool_use|tool_result|all (default:
                        "all")
  --limit-sessions <n>  Max sessions to return (default: 20)
  --limit-hits <n>      Max matches per session (per kind per session without
                        the session index) (default: 3)
  --context-chars <n>   Characters of context around the match (default: 80)
  --json                Output JSON
  --reindex             Bring the session index up to date first
  --include-archived    Include archived sessions
  --exclude-children    Leave out sessions another session started
  --include-hidden      Include sessions with no visible message
  -h, --help            display help for command
